notes: PRONABEC Beca Generación Bicentenario is a national government scholarship of Peru's Ministry of Education. Candidates choose their own master's/PhD programme abroad from a published list of eligible foreign higher-education institutions (RJ 2953-2026) and prioritised study fields; the scheme has no attached institution and no named supervising professors. Official page verified live at https://www.pronabec.gob.pe/beca-generacion-bicentenario (Convocatoria extraordinaria 2026, 20 integral scholarships). No professor tie exists to record.

Banco de la República patronage programme is a government scheme: candidates apply to and are accepted by foreign universities of recognised excellence of their own choosing (3 doctoral slots in economics restricted to top-20 doctoral programmes, 2 master's slots in public administration/public policy from the Bank's listed programmes, 1 slot in economic law from the Bank's listed universities, 1 slot in music). The scheme attaches no institution and no named professors; selection is by a jury of Bank and academic members. The official page https://www.banrep.gov.co/es/contenidos/programas-estudios-el-exterior and the related official page https://www.banrep.gov.co/es/banco/patrocinio-estudios-exterior/generalidades are protected by a Radware bot-manager CAPTCHA that blocked direct fetching; programme content was confirmed through search-engine indexes of those same official banrep.gov.co pages. No professor tie exists to record.

notes: EDFPCIG 2026 call awards one doctoral scholarship (EUR 39,576 over 36 months, funded by the Embassy of France in Peru, IRD and PUCP). Doctoral training alternates: year 1 thesis at PUCP, year 2 research stay at a French partner university of the IRD joint unit, year 3 thesis at PUCP; co-tutela/co-dirección requires a thesis director at each university ('El becario cuenta con un director de tesis de cada universidad (PUCP-Perú y Francia) que deben respaldar la propuesta doctoral'). The PUCP-side supervisors listed are faculty of the PUCP Doctorado en Ingeniería aligned with the school's priority themes (Geociencias, Energía, Medioambiente, Ciencias afines). The French co-director is chosen with the IRD joint-unit partner matching the thesis project and cannot be fixed in advance. All three emails were seen published on official pucp.edu.pe profile pages.

Becas Colombia Biodiversa (Fundación Alejandro Ángel Escobar) is a foundation research grant supporting the applicant's own undergraduate or master's degree thesis at the applicant's own university; applicants must submit a letter from their own thesis director and faculty. The scholarship attaches no institution and no named professors - the thesis director is supplied by the applicant's university. Official instructions page verified live at https://www.faae.org.co/colombiabiodiversa/instrucciones-para-la-aplicacion. No professor tie exists to record.

CONICET Beca Interna Postdoctoral (Convocatoria 2026, 800 fellowships, 36 months from 01/08/2027) is a national research-council call of Argentina. Candidates propose their own research plan, director and host institution within CONICET's network; the call itself attaches no institution and no named supervising professors. Official page verified live at https://convocatorias.conicet.gov.ar/becas/convocatoria-vigente. No professor tie exists to record.

AGCID South-South cooperation scholarship (Chile, 2027 call) is a government scholarship under which professionals from invited countries study a master's at accredited Chilean universities selected through the programme; the official offers page lists courses/calls, not institutions with attached professors. No specific institution or supervising professor is tied to the scholarship itself. Official page verified live at https://www.agcid.gob.cl/becas/becas-para-extranjeros/ofertas-vigentes. No professor tie exists to record.

PEC-PG is Brazil's central government postgraduate exchange programme (Ministry of Foreign Affairs with CNPq). The list of eligible Brazilian HEIs/ICTs is only published in December 2026 and each institution then runs its own candidate selection; no institution or supervising professor is attached to the programme itself. Official page verified live at https://www.gov.br/mre/en/subjects/culture-and-education/educational-themes/study-opportunities-for-international-applicants/pec-pg-graduate/selection-process-2. No professor tie exists to record.
